method: Whole-file manual reading of UiControls.cpp in three ranges; pinned bytes verified. No Windows runtime.
findings: Tab control maps visible native indexes to stable logical indexes, validates index/visibility before activation, chooses another visible tab when hiding active one and notifies parent before/after changes. Return from changing notification is not treated as a veto in this implementation.

Painted tab rectangles are reused for hit testing; active overlapping tab has priority, other tabs checked in reverse order. This keeps hit selection consistent with source draw order, without runtime pixel verification.

Keyboard forwarding requires active pane visible/enabled and redirects focus into it; plain Tab traversal is left to normal dialog handling. Label-only settings tabs retain strip focus, pane-backed tabs redirect away from strip.

RebuildNativeTabs deletes native entries then inserts visible tabs, but insertion return is ignored while logical map advances. Failure can desynchronize map from native control; no failure injection performed.

LayoutPanes clamps bottom-tab remaining height but top-tab rectangle begins at top+tabHeight without equivalent clamp against bottom. Tiny top-tab client areas can produce inverted pane geometry. Actual Window API behavior not tested.

Toolbar AddImage validates bitmap dimensions/byte allocation and requires full GetDIBits transfer, bicubic-scales when dimensions differ, constructs disabled bitmap and rolls back image-list adds when indexes disagree. Resize failure falls back to original bitmap rather than reporting which stage failed.

Disabled icon generation infers alpha presence from any nonzero fourth byte; all-zero alpha32bit source is treated opaque. Channels blended with disabled text and alpha reduced to75percent; premultiplication/fidelity remains unqualified.
Tab/status painting uses full client buffered DC and per-paint brushes/fonts; no cache/performance or tiny-window runtime gate. Theme changes update tab content background.
limits: No Windows focus/tab traversal, paint/hit-test parity, insertion failure, icon alpha, scaling or performance tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
